narratives.Overview:
## Bound remedy (#5541 Prefer-A 6150109598)

1. Add bun.lock and bun.lockb to COVERABLE_BASENAMES; Bun lock diffs stay applicable.
2. Add exact basename .gitignore to INERT_BASENAMES only.
3. After coverable checks, inert repo-root fixtures/ + .json only.
4. Keep unknown fail-closed; do not absorb #5542.
5. Ship closed regression matrix including non-fixtures JSON unknown negatives.
6. file_scope: coverage-applicability (+tests) and CHANGELOG.
